tha-ap275:1.1: samattaṃ. [273. Caṅgoṭakiya.] Mahāsamuddaṃ nissāya vasate pabbatantare / paccuggantvān' akāmāhaṃ caṅgoṭakam adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap275:2.1: Siddhatthassa mahesissa sabbabhūtānukampino / pupphacaṅgoṭakaṃ datvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap275:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe caṅgoṭakam adaṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi caṅgoṭakass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap275:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Caṅgoṭakiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
